title: Environment templates spike: raw-HTTP client + Terraform resource
essence: A spike confirmed that the vendored azure-devops-go-api v7 does NOT expose the environmenttemplates endpoint natively; a raw-HTTP mini-client was implemented instead. On that foundation the full betterado_release_definition_environment_template resource (create/read/delete) was built, registered in provider.go, and covered by unit + acceptance tests — all passing offline.
